Open.description: What the side that opens a channel asks for.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: The id the opener chose: odd for the client of the outer connection, even for its server.

fields.name: family
fields.description: The family the channel will speak.

fields.name: digest
fields.description: The generated declaration digest, exactly 64 lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal characters when present. Absence makes no revision claim.

fields.name: window
fields.description: How many frames the opener will hold in flight before it returns credit.

Opened.description: What the accepting side answers an open with.

Frame.description: One inner frame on a channel: exactly one of text and binary, a binary frame base64.

Credit.description: Credit the receiver returns for frames its consumer took.

Close.description: The close of a channel, travelling in order behind the frames sent before it.
